name: Full Coefficient Model for Arbitrary Directed Graphs
statement: For every finite loopless digraph $G$, the class $C_{\mathrm{uc}}(G)$ is union closed, convex-realizable, dismantlable ample, and finite convex-treelike. Its prescribed coefficient arrays are feasible exactly when $A_vP_e+B_vQ_e>1>A_wP_e+B_wQ_e$ for every arc $e=v\to w$; all other ratios are free. It has $8+7m+23e$ concepts, VC dimension four for $e>0$, and $\mathcal A(C_{\mathrm{uc}}(G))\cong\mathcal Z(G)\times\mathbb R^{d-2m}\cong B_G\times\mathbb R^{d-m}$.
proof: Complementing decreasing intersection-closed fibers gives union closure; the fiber dictionary proves ampleness and the peripheral recursion. Private-coordinate elimination leaves vertex and feedback rows. Each feedback halfplane intersection has an explicit continuous center and radial Euclidean parametrization, while logarithmic vertex ratios give the directed coordinate inequalities.
